research.name: Liqvid
research.note: React library for videos built from live DOM, so viewers can pause and drag, click or edit what is on screen.

effects: videos rendered as live React DOM synced to an audio track, so on-screen elements stay interactive during playback
replay of recorded CodeMirror keystrokes as timed text and cursor events in an editor the viewer can type in
draggable elements inside the video via dragHelperReact and data-affords opt-outs from click-to-pause

unverified: demoViewed is false: no browser was allowed, and the homepage demo (iframe /r/lv-tutorial/) is a JavaScript-rendered player; no screenshot or recording of Liqvid was found on the site, README or docs (only the logo image was viewed).
The signature effects were read from page text, docs and the tutorial's source (recordings.js keystroke data, bundle.js strings such as 'Try changing the background color:'), not seen running.
The Product Hunt gallery images returned for the Liqvid listing showed an unrelated product (BhaiLang), so they were not used as evidence.
requiresHostedService false is inferred from docs stating Node.js is the only dependency and the tutorial loading liqvid from unpkg; not tested by running it.
